name: Danse Macabre
source:
Countess Nadia is planning another Masquerade at Vesuvia's palace – but this one will be much more than a fancy ball.

[From [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dorian.playtogether]Dorian app[/url]]
translation:
娜迪亚女伯爵正在维苏维亚的王宫里筹备又一场假面舞会——但这一次，绝不仅仅是一场华丽的社交舞会那么简单。

[摘自[url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dorian.playtogether]Dorian应用[/url]]
